name: Lessons Anew
summary: In Thunder Bluff, Turak Runetotem sends young tauren druids to sacred Moonglade to learn the cleansing of poisons. Under Dendrite Starblaze, a night elf druid, apprentices begin that study as real poisonings call for more than practice.

sections.title: The Gift of Cenarius
sections.body: Cenarius granted druids an incantation to purge virulent toxins, and charged them to protect the wilds. Turak Runetotem teaches that such magic needs a firm grounding. Before using it to clear a blight, a druid must understand venom’s physical toll and learn to treat it by ordinary means.

sections.title: Summons to Nighthaven
sections.body: Turak sends promising acolytes north from Mulgore along sacred pathways to Moonglade. There, in the peaceful village of Nighthaven, ancient night elf mentors such as Dendrite Starblaze teach practitioners of both elf and tauren kind. Their shared study reflects the Cenarion Circle’s delicate truce, rising above the political strife between Horde and Alliance.

sections.title: A Real Crisis in the Barrens
sections.body: Near the Crossroads in the Barrens, uncontrolled poisonings spread among the animals. Dendrite Starblaze has no time for practice: a plea for aid has come from the Crossroads. That request turns a rite of passage into urgent fieldwork, where young druids face the suffering of wild beasts.

faq.q: Who offers this quest and where do I find them?
faq.answer: Turak Runetotem, the tauren druid trainer, offers the rite on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. He calls on initiates who have shown an early commitment to the Cenarion teachings.

aliases: who is the night elf in moonglade
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze is an elder night elf druid who lives in Nighthaven, Moonglade. Despite tensions between night elves and tauren, he teaches young druids of both races the traditions of the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: What power is this quest teaching me?
faq.answer: Your instruction begins with Cure Poison. The lessons cover venom’s physical and magical nature and teach druids to purge harmful afflictions from allies and wild creatures in their care.

faq.q: Why does a tauren have to study under a night elf?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle is a neutral brotherhood devoted to nature’s balance. Night elves first formalized modern druidism under Cenarius, then welcomed the tauren back into the order and shared sacred places such as Moonglade despite the faction war.

faq.q: What is happening at the Crossroads?
faq.answer: Wildlife around the Crossroads in the Barrens suffers an aggressive wave of poisonings that local handlers cannot contain. Dendrite Starblaze turns your training toward the field, where you are to find the source and make a remedy.

faq.q: What is the fastest way to get to Moonglade for this quest?
faq.answer: As a druid, you have the innate spell Teleport: Moonglade, which takes you straight to Nighthaven. It spares you a journey on foot through treacherous contested lands.

angles.text: As a druid, you move from basic shapeshifting and skirmishing toward stewardship of the wilds. Your path now begins with learning Cure Poison.
As a tauren, your pilgrimage shows how deeply the Earth Mother's children have reconnected with Cenarius's teachings alongside their night elf peers.
As a member of the Horde, you can find safe harbor in Moonglade under the Cenarion Circle's sacred protection, even while Horde warriors clash with night elves in Ashenvale.
